text:
Maria F.: Heads-up — Thirdway applied a $12,000 promo credit but it landed on the pilot account (ACC-PLT-99) instead of the enterprise billing entity (ACC-ENT-42).
Jason S.: ugh. which invoice shows it?
Maria F.: INV-2026-127 shows -$12,000 line. we expected the credit on INV-2026-125 (enterprise).
Olivia O.: do we have the PO mapped? iirc the PO for the pilot is separate.
Yang B.: pulling ledger now, brb. looks like GL code 6102 got the credit (pilot), should be 6105 (enterprise SaaS).
Alex (Thirdway): sorry about that — we rolled credits from a promotional batch. can confirm where it was applied, and can reissue a correcting journal.
Maria F.: thanks. can you either 1) move the credit to INV-2026-125 or 2) issue a one-time invoice credit to ACC-ENT-42 and a correction for ACC-PLT-99? legal prefers moving if possible.
Alex (Thirdway): option 1 is slightly slower (needs internal approvals) but doable. option 2 we can do today as a stopgap (we'll send a negative invoice line). preference?
Jason S.: prefer 1 if it won't delay renewal billing. what's ETA?
Alex (Thirdway): internal approval ~72hrs. if you need immediate fix we can do option 2 now and reconcile after approval.
Maria F.: if they do option 2, please include a reference to the original invoice and the contract clause. we need traceability for audit. example text: "Credit applied in error; corrective allocation to INV-2026-125 per SOW #3."
InvoiceBot: automated notice — INV-2026-127 payment still open: $4,200 due 2026-05-12.
Yang B.: quick ask for accounting — if we do option 2 (vendor issues corrective negative invoice), do we want them to post a debit memoir we post an internal reversing entry? either way GL will need a matching supporting document.
Olivia O.: vendor debit memo preferred. keeps vendor-facing docs consistent.
Maria F.: Alex — can you confirm you'll send a vendor debit memo + mention SOW #3 and the enterprise account tag? also please CC finance@redwood.com on the memo and include the new invoice number so our AR can auto-match.
Alex (Thirdway): yes — will send debit memo today to finance@redwood.com and cc jason@redwood.com. i'll request the allocation change and update you in ~72hrs.
Jason S.: thanks. Maria, Yang — once they send the memo i'll route to AR for matching and add a short note to the renewal packet so sales ops knows why the ARR looks off this month.
Maria F.: perfect. logging this as vendor action item. i will follow up if anything doesn't arrive by EOD PST tomorrow.
Olivia O.: tagging for approvals: @jason-sales please ack signoff for allowing interim debit memo.
Jason S.: ack. go ahead. :white_check_mark:
Maria F.: thanks everyone — keeping thread for audit trail.
